summary_en: The paper develops a multimodal optical coherence photoacoustic microscopy platform for label-free three-dimensional imaging of cancer organoids and spheroids. Optical coherence microscopy supports longitudinal organoid tracking and AI-based viability analysis, while photoacoustic microscopy adds absorption contrast for mapping melanin-positive cells inside mixed spheroids.

summary_en: This work presents a fully metal-free wearable fiber-optoacoustic system that combines focused optical ultrasound generation with fiber-laser detection. It reconstructs beat-to-beat arterial waveforms, validates physiological monitoring across healthy volunteers, and demonstrates artifact-free operation inside an active 3 T MRI scanner.

summary_en: FM-Adapt uses photoacoustic supervision to parameter-efficiently adapt a SAM-based vision transformer for interventional ultrasound. The resulting models perform real-time needle tracking and breast-tumor segmentation while preserving native clinical image resolution and fine-tuning only the mask decoder.
